description:
pkix-path/src/lib.rs:655 — `validate_path` has a `# Errors` section but it only says 'Returns Err on the first RFC 5280 §6.1 check failure' and does not enumerate the individual error variants.

pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:171 — `RevocationChecker::check_revocation` has a general doc but no `# Errors` section listing concrete error variants.

pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:216 — `build_path` DOES have a proper `# Errors` section (well done). 

Convention per Rust API guidelines (C-FAILURE-DOCS): public functions returning `Result` should document each error variant in a `# Errors` section. The existing sections are incomplete:

For `validate_path`, add an enumeration of the main variants: `SignatureInvalid`, `MalformedCertificate`, `ValidityPeriod`, `ChainBroken`, `NoTrustedPath`, `PathTooLong`, `NotCA`, `KeyUsageMissing`, `UnhandledCriticalExtension`, etc.

For `RevocationChecker::check_revocation`, add that callers should expect `Revoked`, `CrlExpired`, `CrlIssuerMismatch`, etc. depending on the implementation.
title: Add # Errors doc sections to validate_path, build_path, and RevocationChecker trait methods
